title: Donkey Kong Bananza Music Disc Pack
description: Nintendo Music Disc Series: VOLUME V
body:
DISCLAIMER: I am currently working on a [mod adding items and music discs from the entire Donkey Kong series.](https://modrinth.com/mod/nmdonkeykong). Because of this, this data pack will no longer be receiving any major updates.

This Data and Resource Pack collection adds 9 craftable music discs from Donkey Kong Bananza.

### TRACKLIST
All track names are sourced from the Nintendo Music app.
- Lagoon Layer
- Canyon Layer
- Battle Challenge
- 2D Challenge Course 1 (DK Island Swing)
- Kong Bananza
- Zebra Bananza
- Ostrich Bananza
- Breaking Through (Heart of Gold)
- Emerald Rish #1

Due to this game not having an official soundtrack release outside of Nintendo Music, song length and audio quality may not 100% reflect how it appears on the app.

### CRAFTING GUIDE
A smithing table is required to obtain discs added in these packs. The recipes are displayed in the Advancements tab, which unlocks when you obtain any Music Disc and a Block of Amethyst. The Advancement tab shows a checklist of each song with the required *"addition"* item needed to obtain it as the Advancement icon.
